rationale: Top-performing videos by retention (97.74%, 75.97%, 67.84%) are all in the 45-60 second range. The current 75-second duration may be pushing past the optimal Short attention window. Reducing to 60 seconds will force tighter, more focused explanations while maintaining educational value.
expected_impact: Increase average retention from ~45% to 55-65% by matching the sweet spot of high-retention videos

rationale: Videos with lower media item counts appear to maintain higher retention, suggesting viewers prefer focused visual storytelling over rapid-fire scene changes. Reducing max media items from 14 to 10 will encourage deeper visual exploration of each concept rather than surface-level coverage of many steps.
expected_impact: Improve engaged view rate from ~25% to 30-35% by reducing cognitive load and allowing viewers to absorb each visual concept
